title: ElCompaPollo
description:
ElCompaPollo is a datapack in which he puts together various data packs that he created:
Infusion of Magma
Amplified TNT
fried eggs
Reality Climbing Spiders
counting Blocks
the remove and crystal and Tnt
body:
## **Magma Infusion**
![Magma Infusion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e26d446f73383fbc7695c9a64a48e86c4be16ee.webp)

This data pack causes the magma block to burn the items on it once you throw the object, a counter is placed on top of the object when it reaches 10, the object disappears in a small explosion that does not hurt you or break anything, but destroys the object.

## **Amplified TNT**
![Amplified TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64f5db31852053637499afefb46080f6050ce709.webp)

Instructions:
How to turn it on?
To turn on the Amplified TNT, you need to place a redstone block next to the TNT. Keep in mind that if you try to light it by clicking with a lighter or placing it near the fire, it will not activate
How can I increase the explosion level?
Just throw gunpowder on the block. Each time you do this, the number at the top will increase (with a limit of 12 units of powder per block). Also, keep in mind that the explosion radius will also increase with each powder.

## **Fryed Eggs**

![Fryed Eggs (craft 1/3)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49ad341fd0be3ff2e2a3e0dd3cd62393dd9ee22e.webp)
![Fryed Eggs (craft 2/3)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35e7dde4d61dede5bbdac4d9ae3dc91bcff8ec24.webp)
![Fryed Eggs (craft 3/3)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5f3f2690cde1cb04ed2c0800104dc25cd14dab1.webp)

Fried eggs is a Data pack that adds different ways to cook eggs and other dishes that are usually eaten for breakfast

## **Spiders Reality Climbing**

![Spiders Reality Climbing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f2f75e65da8ab5696bdfd8307f07766a5004fc4.webp)

This Data pack modifies spiders to have a size similar to real life but so little so exaggerated to be able to kill them facially.

## **Count Blocks**

![Count Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c0d92082c07f986c90da45dfc5be1b659dc3dbe.webp)

This datapack adds a number to the items you have on the floor and if you throw an item that cannot be stacked in 64 its name is added

## **The remove end crystal and Tnt**

![The remove end crystal and Tnt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ae1f584550fbb82700281376247221f8a18f004.webp)

To remove the End Crystal or the lit tnt what you have to do is throw a pair of scissors where the End Crystal or the tnt is placed
Note: The scissors disappear when you touch the tnt or the End Crystal
